description:
Permanently deactivate one sub-agent key by delegate_id, or all active sub-keys when revoke_all=true. Use this to retire an unused or compromised sub-key; do not use for a temporary account-wide pause (x402_set_account_freeze) or budget edits (x402_update_delegate_key).
Parameters: pass delegate_id or revoke_all=true (revoke_all takes priority if both are set); supply your main spend_key or header (mismatch -> HTTP 400).
Behavior: permanent — deactivated keys immediately return HTTP 401. Safe to retry; returns HTTP 403 for sub-keys and HTTP 404 if unknown.

delegate_id.description: Unique delegated subagent key identifier returned by x402_issue_delegate_key or x402_get_account (format: sbd_<16 hex chars>, e.g. sbd_1122334455667788).

reason.description: Optional audit-log reason recorded on swarm revocations when revoke_all=true (e.g. "key_rotated" or "compromised_worker").

revoke_all.description: Set true to immediately deactivate every active sub-agent key on the account at once (omit delegate_id when true).

spend_key.description: Master Stripe account spend key (format: sbk_<43+ chars>). Delegated subagent keys are rejected with HTTP 403. Optional if supplied via the x-atlas-spend-key HTTP header.

name: x402_revoke_delegate_key

revoked.description: True when a single delegated key was revoked.

revoked_count.description: Number of delegated keys revoked when revoke_all=true.

title: Deactivate Sub-Agent Key
